caveats: baseline_analysed includes the 5-day window extensions beyond the 1992-2002 baseline (1991-12-27 to 2003-01-05) that the method includes in the pools of the first/last days; day 60 pools are empty by construction and its threshold/climatology was set to the mean of days 59 and 61 before 31-day wrap-around smoothing. Thresholds computed with numpy nanquantile(method='hazen') and nanmean on float64, as specified. Per-cell MHWs are runs of >=5 hot days (SST >= threshold) merged when separated by <=2 days; regional events are maximal runs of days with at least one cell in an MHW.
